FEATURE: Gameplay residency / simulation streaming for characters, WorldObjects, encounters, and procedural world content.

SOURCE: Architecture direction was developed on `docs/worldbuilder-hybrid-authored-procedural` through commit `deedc894b25fe8e45856e607464610c9da9599e6`. This SceneIssue copies the binding implementation plan and task list so execution does not depend on that branch.

ACCEPTANCE: Implement one gameplay-residency coordinator that aggregates semantic fidelity demands without owning domain state; preserve stable identities across Dormant/Coarse/Detailed transitions; coordinate detailed simulation with physical world residency; keep network interest and Unity presentation lifetime distinct; reuse existing Character, CharacterAI, WorldObject, Encounter, persistence, WorldBuilder, and VoxelEngine streaming authorities; prove deterministic transitions and independent reuse; pass repository-selected exact-SHA validation and blast-radius/cost checks. No parallel character/object/encounter/persistence/streaming systems.

WORKFLOW: Follow `AGENTS.md`, `SceneIssues/feature-readme.md`, and `SceneIssues/README.md`. Work the next unchecked non-blocked task; record blockers and continue independent work; no opportunistic enhancements. If a prerequisite gameplay system is not yet available, record the blocker and continue independent contract/tests that do not weaken acceptance. After two materially different fixes fail the same acceptance symptom/assertion, isolate a minimal repro/root cause before another fix.
